meta.title: POS Pro — Point of sale for restaurants and supermarkets in the DRC
meta.description: POS Pro, M-SEC's point of sale for restaurants, bars, supermarkets and shops in the DRC: offline, CDF and USD, mobile money, stock, barcodes and reports. Ask for a demo on WhatsApp.

hero.title: The point of sale that keeps selling, even when the internet drops.
hero.desc: For restaurants, bars, supermarkets and shops in the DRC: CDF and USD payments, mobile money, stock and reports, on a Windows computer, an Android tablet or phone.

editions.label: Two editions
editions.title: Pick the edition that fits your business
editions.desc: One software: your subscription turns on the Restaurant edition, the Supermarket edition, or both.

items.name: POS Pro Restaurant
points: Floor plan, tables and waiter orders on a phone
Kitchen and bar tickets by station, kitchen screen
Dish options (cooking, extras), starter / main / dessert courses
Split and merge bills, tips, takeaway and delivery

items.tag: Supermarkets, convenience stores, shops, hardware stores
items.name: POS Pro Supermarket
points: Fast checkout with keyboard and scanner, sales by weight
EAN, UPC and Code 128 barcodes, labels and internal codes
Multi-warehouse stock, batches and expiry dates, scan stocktakes
Supplier purchasing, receipts, invoices and payables
Promotions, coupons, loyalty points and gift cards

features.label: In both editions
features.title: Built for the realities of the Congolese market

items.title: Offline first
items.desc: The till keeps taking payments without internet and syncs as soon as the connection returns.

items.title: CDF and USD
items.desc: Prices and payments in both currencies, at the daily rate you enter.

items.title: DRC mobile money
items.desc: M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Orange Money and Afrimoney, plus cash and change.

items.title: Receipts and devices
items.desc: ESC/POS receipt printers 58 and 80 mm, cash drawer, scanner, customer display and scale.

items.title: Reports and insights
items.desc: X and Z reports, sales by product, cashier and hour, margins, stockouts and upcoming expiries.

items.title: Security
items.desc: Roles and permissions, manager PIN for sensitive actions, audit log, daily encrypted backups.

items.title: DGI standardised invoice
items.desc: Gapless numbering, locked invoices and Z report prepared; connection to the e-MCF device after DGI approval.

items.title: All your devices
items.desc: Windows app, Android app and an installable web version for iPhone.

plans.label: Plans
plans.title: Plans for every business size
plans.desc: Prices are quoted on request during the pilot programme. Ask for yours on WhatsApp: reply within one business day.
